notes.title: Problems to file missing or Cannot run the game.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

"file missing "
The previous game file cannot be downloaded is due to the fact that it have set to be available in English only recently, 
That means for anyone how are not running STEAM in English, will not download the depot contents.

I have change the game to be available for all languages .
Please try to install it again, Thank you.

"Cannot run this game"
This game is set to be operated in Windows with HTC Vive setup.
For those who are not using windows OS or do not have HTC VIVE,
this game cannot be run  normally.

If you have any question about this game,
feel free to contact us.
Thank You

Team studio_mori
